content.short: Armors offers blockchain code auditing, security testing, monitoring, and alarming services.
content.description: Armors, founded in 2017, is a blockchain security team focused on implementing and securing the underlying technology. It has established relationships with exchanges such as OKEx, Binance, Bybit, Huobi, Bitfinex, KuCoin, MXC, and Bibox to provide code audit services. In addition to Solidity and Rust smart contracts, Armors has researched Move language and now offers Move audits to protect project assets. Armors is an audit partner of BSC, Ethereum, Polygon, Solana, and other public chains. It provides services such as security audits, penetration testing, cross-chain migration, and platform security for over 2,000 blockchain projects and assets worth more than $100 billion. The audit process includes evaluating the smart contract, auditing, and delivering the audit report on time, with recommendations to modify issues as needed.
